description: This file contains simulation adapters for external systems used by the DU Health Check application, including simulated interactions with Vault, Kubernetes, Kafka, and Loki. It provides mock implementations of functions and classes that mimic real external system interactions for development and CI environments.

classes.name: _SimPod
classes.description: Represents a simulated Kubernetes Pod with attributes for name, namespace, labels, phase, IPs, and containers.

classes.name: _SimCoreApi
classes.description: Mock class simulating kubernetes.client.CoreV1Api, providing methods to list nodes, list pods, and read pod logs in a simulated environment.

methods.name: str simulated_fetch_kubeconfig_from_vault( vault_addr: str, token: str, secret_path: str, timeout: float = 8.0 )
methods.description: Returns a fabricated kubeconfig string for simulation, logging the request details.

methods.name: Tuple[_SimCoreApi,object] simulated_build_k8s_client_from_kubeconfig(kubeconfig_content: str)
methods.description: Creates and returns simulated Kubernetes API clients and an Apps client object.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] simulated_list_nodes(core_api: _SimCoreApi, label_selector: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of fabricated node information, including one ready and one not-ready node.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] simulated_list_pods(core_api: _SimCoreApi, namespace: str, label_selector: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of simulated pods with container statuses, based on the mock data.

methods.name: Tuple[int,str,str] simulated_safe_exec_command(core_api: _SimCoreApi, namespace: str, pod: str, container: str, command: List[str], timeout_seconds: int = 8)
methods.description: Simulates execution of commands inside pods, returning deterministic outputs for monitoring commands.

methods.name: None simulated_send_to_kafka(bootstrap_servers: str, topic: str, payload: Dict[str, Any], logger: logging.Logger)
methods.description: Pretends to send data to Kafka, logging the action and payload size.

methods.name: None simulated_push_to_loki(loki_url: str, tenant_id: Optional[str], labels: str, entries: List[Dict[str, Any]], logger: logging.Logger)
methods.description: Pretends to push logs to Loki, logging the payload details.
